# VER pk mu siglen sig expect_result expect_reason
#   siglen precedes the signature because the signature is
#   variable length: the length branch needs a short one.
#   reason: 0 ok, 1 length, 2 hint decode, 3 z bound, 4 c_tilde mismatch

# VP2 w[0] after the matrix computation and INTT
# VP3 w1[0] after UseHint
